_comment: Copy to .mcp.json in the root of the repository whose docs you want kept in step,
or run: claude mcp add docsync -- docsync serve --registry .
No API key here on purpose. docsync reads SUPERDOCS_API_KEY from the .env file next
to your docsync.yaml, which is the file your .gitignore already covers. A key in an
editor config is a key in a file people commit.
